The level of technology and innovation in the Jujutsu Kaisen world is the same as the one in the real world at around 2017. So actual armor is not easily found.

Many sorcerers and curse users will wear armor and gear that makes combating curses easier, though some may opt to wear heavy armor to help them last in battle. Metallic Heavy armor takes a lot of upkeep hinders mobility, and should not be preferred when used in public. Therefore, you must find vendors who will sell effective equipment that works for a life of sorcery. It is up to each character and their class to decide what armor is worth using.

The Armor table shows the cost, weight, and other properties of the common types of armor worn in the world of Jujutsu Kaisen.

Armor Proficiency. Anyone can put on a suit of armor or strap a Shield to an arm. Only those proficient in the armor’s use know how to wear it effectively, however. Your class gives you proficiency with certain types of armor. If you wear armor that you lack proficiency with, you have disadvantage on any ability check, saving throw, or Attack roll that involves Strength or Dexterity, and you can't cast Spells.

Stealth. If the Armor table shows Disadvantage, the wearer has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

Shields. Many warrior-type sorcerers supplement their armor with a Shield. A Shield is made from wood or metal and is carried in one hand. Wielding a Shield increases your Armor Class by 2. You can benefit from only one Shield at a time.

Light Armor
Made from light materials and fabrics, light armor provides a solid balance of mobility and protection for the mobile and stealthy types. If you wear light armor, you add your Dexterity modifier to the base number from your armor type to determine your Armor Class.

Dense Coat. This type of coat is made from durable fabrics and materials that provide basic protection.

Thick Shirt. Thicker shirts consist of high-quality quilted cloth or leather that don't hinder flexibility.

Light Bulletproof Shirt. An undershirt consisting of durable synthetic fibers that provides noticeable protection against bullets and other weapons.

Medium Armor
Medium armor is similar to light armor, but sacrifices mobility in exchange for greater protection through its thicker fabrics and materials. If you wear medium armor, you add your Dexterity modifier, to a maximum of +2, to the base number from your armor type to determine your Armor Class.

Hide. This crude armor is made from various thick beast skins and pelts. Tribal groups, evil humanoids, and savages often wear this type of material for protection.

Bulletproof Jacket. A protective jacket consisting of durable synthetic fibers that provides decent protection against bullets and other weapons without making too much noise.

Bulletproof Suit. This armor consists of fully bulletproof materials made from durable synthetic fibers. Your vital organs are completely protected by this suit, though your legs and arms are left partially uncovered.

Heavy Armor
Although not always preferred for sorcery, heavy armor can provide the greatest protection out of any type of armor. It is worn by those who possess great strength and juggernaut capabilities.
Heavy armor doesn't let you add your Dexterity modifier to your Armor Class, but it also doesn't penalize you if your Dexterity modifier is negative.

Ring Mail. This armor is leather armor with heavy rings sewn into it. The rings help reinforce the armor against blows from swords and axes. Ring mail is inferior to chain mail, and it's usually worn only by those who can’t afford better armor.

Chain Mail. Made of interlocking metal rings, chain mail includes a layer of quilted fabric worn underneath the mail to prevent chafing and cushion the impact of blows. The suit includes gauntlets.

Plate Armor. Consists of shaped, interlocking steel plates to cover the entire body. A suit of plate includes gauntlets, heavy leather boots, giant shoulder plates, and thick layers of padding underneath the armor. Sometimes it comes with a coating.

Your class grants proficiency in certain weapons, reflecting both the class's focus and the tools you are most likely to use. Whether you favor a longsword or a pistol, your weapon and your ability to wield it effectively can mean the difference between life and death while killing curses.

The Weapons table shows the most common weapons used in the world of Jujutsu Kaisen, their price and weight, the damage they deal when they hit, and any special properties they possess. Every weapon is classified as either melee or ranged. A melee weapon is used to attack a target within 5 feet of you, whereas a ranged weapon is used to attack a target at a distance.

Weapon Proficiency
Your race, class, and feats give you the ability to gain Proficiency in certain types of weapons. These types of weapons are categorized as simple and martial.

When you have proficiency in a weapon type, you can add your proficiency bonus to the attack roll. When you don't have proficiency in a weapon type, you do not add your proficiency bonus to the roll.

Weapon Properties
The different types of special weapon properties are listed on the different Weapons table. These include ammunition, finesse, heavy, light, loading, range, reach, special, thrown, two-handed, and versatile. These properties function the same as they do in standard 5th edition D&D rules.

Improvised Weapons
When characters decide to use a tool or item that could be used as a potential weapon, the DM may allow them to use it as an improvised weapon. If a character is proficient with improvised weapons or if the improvised weapon is similar to a type of weapon, such as a club, the DM may allow the character to add their proficiency bonus to the attack roll.

When an improvised weapon is used, the damage die is a 1d4 (the damage type is decided by the DM based on the weapon). It may be used as a melee weapon or a thrown weapon depending on the weapon. An improvised thrown weapon has a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet.

Special Weapons
Weapons with special rules are described here.

Lance. You have disadvantage when you use a lance to attack a target within 5 feet of you. Also, a lance requires two hands to wield when you aren’t mounted.

Weighted Chain. A Large or smaller creature hit by a chain is restrained until it is freed. A chain does not affect creatures that are tiny or creatures that are Huge or larger. A creature can use its action to make a DC 14 Strength check, freeing itself or a creature within reach on a success.

Fist. A weapon with the fist property counts as being an unarmed strike and/or weapon attack for any feature or technique that requires it to be.

Defensive. While wielding a defensive weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to AC. You can only gain this bonus from one weapon at a time.

Your basic items used on day to day sorcery work. All are equal to 5e with the addition of cellphones at a cost of $400.

Equipment Packs
The starting equipment you get from your clan or school includes a collection of useful adventuring gear, put together in a pack. The contents of these packs are listed here. You can also buy these packs from your clan or school if they have them available. Each pack contains a unique cursed tool that provides some benefit.

Explorer's Pack ($1,600)
Contains a hiking backpack, sleeping bag, portable stove, lighter, flashlight, 10 spare batteries, 10 pre-packaged meals, a canteen, 60 feet of climbing rope and an energy tag made by fermenting in cursed energy for 100 years. You can rip the charm to regain 3 cursed energy.
Dungeoneer's Pack ($1,200)
Contains a heavy-duty duffel bag, crowbar, utility hammer, climbing spikes, flashlight, 10 glowsticks, lighter, 10 ready meals, hydration pack, 60 feet of durable rope, and a basic cursed tool knife.

Burglar's Pack ($1,600)
Contains a compact backpack, steel bearings, nylon wire, small bell alarm, compact crowbar, hammer, climbing hooks, flashlight, 2 bottles of oil, 5 energy bars, lighter, water bottle, 60 feet of rope, and a bundle of binding cord.

Diplomat’s Pack ($3,900)
Contains a sleek suitcase, two document tubes, formal attire, fountain pen, ink refills, smartphone, two spare batteries, five parchment sheets, perfume, wax seal kit, a bar of soap, and a cursed seal stamp.

Entertainer's Pack ($4,000)
Contains a duffel bag, sleeping bag, two performance outfits, makeup kit, five candles, five snacks, a water bottle, a disguise kit, and a trick mirror.

Priest’s Pack ($1,900)
Contains a modern exorcist’s satchel, prayer mat, 10 candles, lighter, alms box, two incense blocks, censer, priest robes, two meals, a water bottle, and a cursed lantern.

Scholar's Pack ($4,000)
Contains a sturdy backpack, notebook, tablet or laptop, stylus pen, 10 sheets of blank paper, sandbag eraser, small utility knife, and a curse detector.
Cursed Tools
Items, both brand new items and others from antiquity who are embedded with curses, since normal weapons cannot damage cursed spirits. These weapons are organized by grade 4th grade(Common), 3rd grade(Uncommon), 2nd grade(Rare), 1st grade(Very Rare), Special grade(Legendary).

Imbued Items
These items are just simple weapons and day to day objects imbued with cursed energy, thus they are able to hurt things such as curses.
—————————————————————————————————
Cursed Glasses
These are glasses with lenses embedded with cursed energy allowing those who wear it to see curses if they otherwise would not be able to.

Binding Cord
A bundle of cord soaked with the blood of cursed spirits and carries a pungent smell. Low grade curses cannot phase through these cords as they can with most physical objects and can therefore be used to bind and restrain them.

Trick Mirror
A small handheld mirror. Normally curses do not have reflections and do not appear in photographs. However, using this trick mirror, you can see curses in the mirror’s reflection.

Improved Items
These items are filled with Cursed Energy which allows them to become more effective. This is represented by gaining a +1 bonus to related activities.
—————————————————————————————————
Minor Technique Items
Items that hold an innate technique are found in many different grades of strength. Mechanically, these are all 5e Uncommon items that aren't +1 items.

Basic Cursed Tool Knife
An ordinary steel blade etched with faint markings that allow it to cut low-grade curses or weak barriers. The knife counts as a 4th grade cursed tool. While within 5 ft of a barrier, you can spend half a minute to discreetly cut a 5 ft hole in a Basic Curtain or similarly weak barrier without alerting the one who placed it. You can use the knife in this way three times before it breaks and becomes unusable.

Curse Detector
A small device resembling a geiger counter with a simple screen. You can use this item to gain advantage on a Wisdom or Cursed Energy (Perception) check to locate residuals, curses and cursed energy. On a success, you can track where the cursed energy trail leads you and you are aware of whose cursed energy it is if you are familiar with them. The DC equals the cursed energy save DC of the creature being tracked. You can use this item a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus before it needs to be recharged by spending 1 cursed energy.

Cursed Lantern
A small paper lantern inlaid with paper tags to detect cursed energy. You can spend 1 cursed energy to light the lantern for 1 hour. It glows brighter when near cursed energy and sputters violently when near a cursed spirit, shikigami, or cursed corpse.

Improved Items
These items are filled with Cursed Energy which allows them to become more effective. This is represented by adding a +2 to related things.
—————————————————————————————————
Par Technique Items
Items that hold a technique are found in many different grades of strength. Mechanically, these are 5e Rare items that aren't +2.

Hand Sword
Weapon (Shortsword), Grade 2
When attacking with the Cursed Hand Sword you gain a +2 to attack and damage rolls and advantage on ability checks or saving throws against being disarmed of this weapon.
You can choose to remotely control it to move and attack as a bonus action. The weapon moves up to 25 feet and makes one attack per turn and remains active while within 100 ft. When attacking remotely, use your Cursed Energy modifier for attack rolls, and deal 2d10 slashing damage (no ability modifier). You can command it to travel somewhere or target a creature as an action, not requiring actions.
—————————————————————————————————
Cursed Seal Stamp
A small stamp with the seal of your sorcerer clan or a different organization you are affiliated with. By spending 1 cursed energy, you can stamp a contract with your seal to agree to a binding vow within the contents of a contract. These are usually used for long and complicated binding vows or to make a binding vow without meeting in person. If the contract or the contents of the contract is changed or altered in any way, the stamp is invalidated and must be reapplied.

Improved Items
These items are filled with Cursed Energy which allows them to become more effective. This is represented by adding a +3 to related activities.
—————————————————————————————————
Major Technique Items
Items that hold an innate technique are found in many different grades of strength. Mechanically, these are all 5e Very Rare items.

—————————————————————————————————
Dragon Bone
Weapon(Scimitar), Grade 1

Once per turn, you can gain a bonus to an attack or damage roll made with this cursed tool equal to 1/3 of the slashing damage dealt by your last attack (rounded down).

—————————————————————————————————
Claws of Calamity
Weapon(Gauntlets), Grade 1

When attacking with the Claws of Calamity you gain a +3 to attack and damage rolls, and deal 1d12 bludgeoning, slashing or piercing damage. The damage required for Limb Removal for arms increases by 20.

—————————————————————————————————
Black Rope
Weapon(Whip), Grade 1

When you attack using this weapon you can use a charge that makes it so all magic and cursed energy features are deactivated. However, for every hit this effect is active, you subtract one from your hit and damage bonus, once you reach a -5 Black Rope will burn away.

Improved Items
These items are filled with Cursed Energy which allows them to become more effective. This is represented by adding a +4 to related things.
—————————————————————————————————
Top Technique Items
Items that hold an innate technique are found in many different grades of strength. Mechanically, these are all 5e Legendary and above items.
—————————————————————————————————
Chain of 1000 Miles
Weapon(Weighted Chain), Special Grade

You have a +4 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this cursed tool. In addition, as a bonus action, you can add 60ft to the range as long as one end is covered. You can also add a light weapon to the chain’s end.
—————————————————————————————————
Festering Life Sword
Weapon(Shortsword), Special Grade

You have a +4 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this cursed tool. On a hit with this weapon, the target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure they take 6d10 necrotic damage.
—————————————————————————————————
Inverted Spear of Heaven
Weapon(Dagger), Special Grade

You have a +4 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this cursed tool. All magic and cursed energy-related features are deactivated against this weapon.
—————————————————————————————————

Playful Cloud
Weapon(Three Segment Staff), Special Grade

You have a +4 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this cursed tool. In addition while wielding this weapon you gain a +1 bonus to AC and on a hit you gain a bonus to damage equal to 3 times your (Strength modifier + 4).
—————————————————————————————————
Soul Split Katana
Weapon(Katana), Special Grade

You have a +4 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this cursed tool. Attacks made with this weapon ignores resistances and immunities and damage from this sword reduces the maximum hit points of the target until a long rest.
—————————————————————————————————
Sword of Extermination
Weapon(Shortsword), Special Grade

You have a +4 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this cursed tool. On a hit, a cursed spirit must make a DC 30 Constitution saving throw, being exorcised instantaneously on a failed save.

Conventional weapons such as katanas can become semi-cursed tools over time if the user constantly imbues it with their cursed energy. Semi Cursed Tools are not as powerful as full Cursed Tools and are more prone to being broken. They are considered weaker than tools of the same grade and reduce their effect by one grade if not imbued with cursed energy at least once a week + 1 week per grade above 4th.

Semi Cursed Tool Creation
Requirements: Cursed Imbuement, Cursed Enhancement, Tool Maker, or Basic Cursed Energy Manipulation

CE Cost: When using Cursed Imbuement or Cursed Energy Manipulation, you create a Semi Grade Cursed Tool after using the specified cursed energy with that weapon.
Time Cost: When using Cursed Enhancement, you create a Semi Grade Cursed Tool after using it in combat every day for a specified time.

Grade CE Time Effect
Semi Grade 4 50 50 days Becomes basic cursed tool, can affect cursed spirits
Semi Grade 3 100 100 days Gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls
Semi Grade 2 200 150 days Gains a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls
Semi Grade 1 300 300 days Gains a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls

Tool Makers can use either method at half the cost (rounded up).

Variant Rule: Technique Imbued Cursed Tools
This variant rule serves to allow players to obtain cursed tools more easily, imbuing their innate technique into it. After a creature has imbued a weapon with Cursed Energy at least 150 times, while having spent the maximum energy possible every time, the most basic form of the innate technique will be imbued into the weapon, which will gain the following properties:

  • A creature can use said technique without spending Cursed Energy a number of times per day equal to the CE modifier of the creature who imbued the technique into the weapon.

  • The weapon is now considered a Semi-Special Grade Cursed Tool.

A creature does not need to possess Cursed Energy in order to use the technique imbued into the weapon. Each Technique Imbued Tool may have varying effects depending on the Innate Technique imbued within them.
Only the first maximum infusion of cursed energy performed outside of combat each day counts towards creating a tool like this, unlike in combat where all are counted as normal. Only one technique can be imbued within a tool and a creature can only create one tool this way.
